owns: information architecture for recruiter and technical web surfaces
design tokens, responsive layout, and visual hierarchy
accessible semantic HTML and resilient CSS
SEO, social metadata, and machine-readable discovery
does_not_own: client-side behavior that weakens inspectability without a demonstrated need

activation.core_law: Design must increase comprehension and trust without hiding limits, uncertainty, or evidence state.

governing_laws: The strongest proof and role clarity must be visible within the first review screen.
Visual prominence must track decision relevance and evidence strength.
Accessibility, responsive behavior, and content integrity are release requirements, not optional polish.
The web surface may project canonical facts but may not fork them.
Interactive complexity must earn its cost and authority.
Every public download must resolve to the exact approved artifact.

forbidden: hiding evidence limits in low-contrast or inaccessible presentation
using fabricated testimonials, logos, affiliations, metrics, or social proof
shipping broken or unverified artifact links
using dark patterns, manipulative urgency, or covert tracking
adding client-side scripts without a bounded need and review
representing a template or preview as a production deployment
truth_requirements: content is generated from the canonical resume master
PSYSOC-X controls audience calibration within its boundaries
public artifact URLs and hashes must match the approved manifest
deployment state must be verified independently from source state

verification.status_rule: CANDIDATE until exact-head CI validates composition, template contracts, responsive markers, link policy, and refusal cases
